# Jobby

Jobby does not authorize automated scraping, crawling, bulk extraction,
dataset creation, retrieval-augmented ingestion, model training, model
evaluation, synthetic data generation, or any other AI-related reuse of any
part of this application.

This restriction applies to the entire product, including:
- Public marketing pages
- Pricing pages
- Terms and privacy pages
- Authentication pages
- Dashboard and onboarding routes
- API routes and internal endpoints
- User profiles, CVs, uploaded documents, job reports, match scores, ATS
  reports, interview kits, billing data, and any authenticated user content

AI crawlers, automated agents, and dataset collection systems are not allowed
to access, store, summarize, index, train on, or redistribute Jobby content
without prior written permission.

Contact: contacto@jobby.ai
